name: Xinjiang Tianshan
description: Xinjiang Tianshan protects four separate areas of the Tianshan range in northwest China, covering about 607,000 hectares. Glacier-capped peaks, dense forests, alpine meadows, clear lakes and red sandstone canyons rise above the edge of the Taklimakan Desert. The result is a sharp contrast of ice and sand, and of lush green and barren dryness. Rare plants survive here, and the landscapes have changed little since the Pliocene.
